key.name: modes
key.description: JSON array of mode objects. Edited through the preferences window.

key.name: active-mode
key.description: Empty when no mode is active (custom setup).

key.name: call-app-overrides
key.description: Map of application key to "always" or "never".

key.name: call-app-names
key.summary: Display names for call detection overrides
key.description: Map of application key to its last seen display name.

key.name: call-mode
key.summary: Mode to apply when a call starts
key.description: Empty disables automatic switching. The previous mode is restored when the call ends.

key.name: reapply-on-reconnect
key.summary: Re-apply the active mode when its devices reappear

key.name: show-indicator
key.summary: Show a button in the top bar
